[[Hawke]] must find '''crafting''' recipes and resources and then take them to crafting stations in ''[[Dragon Age II]]''. Once a resource has been located, all crafters will be able to use it. Orders for craftable items may be given from Hawke's home or the crafters themselves: runes in [[Hightown]], poisons and bombs in [[Darktown]], and potions in [[Lowtown]].

Undiscovered component resources will become unavailable over the timespan of the game, so players should keep their eyes open and collect any crafting resources when they see them in case the opportunity to collect that particular resource should be lost. However, if the ''[[The Black Emporium (DLC)|The Black Emporium]]'' [[downloadable content (Dragon Age II)|downloadable content]] is installed, missed ingredients may be bought there. Note that if you don't recruit [[Isabela]], [[Ambrosia]] cannot be obtained.

== Crafting resource locations ==
{{Main|Supplier}}

'''Supplier''' is an [[Achievements (Dragon Age II)|achievement]] in ''[[Dragon Age II]]'', which is obtained by discovering every crafting resource in the game. Every resource must be acquired, even though the achievement states that every variety must be required.

If the act is finished without one of the materials, it becomes impossible to obtain the achievement. If you fail to recruit and keep [[Isabela]] through Act 3 (i.e., make her friend or rival with at least 75% approval before [[To Catch a Thief]]), her Act 3 side quest will be unavailable to you, denying you access to [[Ambrosia]]. You must keep [[Anders]] around as you need to go on a sidequest with him in Act 3 or you will fall one [[Deep Mushroom (Dragon Age II)|Deep Mushroom]] short of the achievement. Side quests with [[Merrill]] will also be required, in particular for but not limited to [[Felandaris (Dragon Age II)]] in Act 3.

If ''[[The Black Emporium (DLC)|The Black Emporium]]'' is installed, purchasing crafting resources at the [[Black Emporium]] counts toward this achievement, as it makes the player's resource count equals 66, no matter the source. You can only purchase crafting resources missed in previous acts, so even with the Black Emporium, you will still need Isabela, Merrill and Anders available in Act 3 to get the Supplier achievement.

== Crafters ==
* [[Elegant|Lady Elegant]] in [[Lowtown]] supplies potions.
* [[Tomwise]] in [[Darktown]] supplies poisons and grenades.
* [[Worthy]] in [[Hightown]] supplies runes.

== Bugs ==
* If two or more crafting resources of the same variety are available at the Black Emporium for purchase (e.g., a stack of elfroots), then all purchased resources of that variety will only count as one, even if purchased one at a time.<ref>[http://social.bioware.com/forum/1/topic/301/index/6497158/2#7160890 BioWare Social Network - "Supplier Achievement - Glitchy at best"]</ref>
* An additional Spindleweed may be available during Act 2 and Act 3 even if you have collected them all. It is advised to ignore the crafting resource as buying it may glitch the Supplier achievement. 
** {{Platforms|pc}} Picking any Spindleweed (example: picking one in lowtown in act 2) before go to the Black Emporium will prevent the bug.
** {{platforms|xbox360}}The achievement seems to operate on a crafting resource counter. When the Spindleweed was purchased from the Black Emporium, the achievement unlocked with one actual in-game crafting resource remaining.

'''Rune of Devastation''' is a [[Weapon runes (Dragon Age II)|weapon rune]] in ''[[Dragon Age II]]''. For more information about the effect, see below.

== Acquisition ==
* {{Currency|7500}}: Crafted, using [[Design: Rune of Devastation]].

== Effect mechanisms ==
Because of the [[Combat_mechanics_(Dragon_Age_II)#Order_of_operations_for_damage|order of operations for damage in Dragon Age II]], this rune is most useful to characters with a high critical hit chance or those who cycle a lot of damage [[Talents (Dragon Age II)|abilities]]/[[Spells (Dragon Age II)|spells]] during combat.

Damage increasing runes, like the [[Rune of Impact]], add 20% of the weapon's base damage, disregarding bonuses by talents or criticals. This rune increases the damage by ''only'' 6% for [[Dual Weapon weapons]], 8% for [[Weapon and Shield weapons]], and 10% for [[Two-Handed weapons]], [[Staves (Dragon Age II)|Staves]] and [[Archery weapons]], but affects all damage, including that from talents and criticals.

However, it is difficult to rely on the Rune of Devastation for critical damage increase because one would need both a high critical chance and, more importantly, a high critical damage multiplier. To parallel the damage increase from a typical damage rune with a rune of devastation requires a 333%, 250%, and 200% critical damage multiplier for the above mentioned weapon types. This is '''only''' for basic attacks. When concerning bonus multipliers from talents, the damage increase given by this rune will be significantly higher than the basic increase from other weapon runes.
